alert_news.title: ToneTag Launches India's First In-Car Fuel Payments on TATA.CARS via UPI Circle & IndianOil
bullets: India’s first in‑car fuel payment solution using NPCI’s UPI Circle, launched by ToneTag with TATA.CARS and IndianOil.
Enables secure, contactless fuel payments directly from the vehicle interface, eliminating the need for a mobile app or card, and integrates with IndianOil’s XTRAREWARDS loyalty program.

alert_news.title: India’s First Flight Acceptance Test of CE20 Engine at 220 kN
bullets: India’s first flight‑acceptance hot test of the CE20 cryogenic engine at uprated thrust of 220 kN conducted at ISRO Propulsion Complex, Mahendragiri.
The CE20 powers the upper cryogenic stage of the LVM3 launch vehicle, boosting payload capacity for Gaganyaan missions.
The test marks a key step toward operationalizing the uprated C32 stage for upcoming LVM3 missions.

alert_news.title: Tata Steel deploys India's first coke oven gas injection technology at Odisha unit
bullets: India’s first coke oven gas injection technology in a blast furnace, commissioned at Tata Steel’s Meramandali plant in Odisha, replacing fossil fuel as a reductant.
The technology, implemented with partners Paul Wurth‑SMS and Kobelco, reduces CO₂ emissions and supports Tata Steel’s Net Zero by 2045 target.

alert_news.title: TCS Launches India's First Lights-Out Factory Lab in Pune for AI-Powered Manufacturing
bullets: India’s first lights‑out factory lab, a fully automated AI‑powered manufacturing facility, opened at TCS’s Sahyadri Park campus in Pune.
The lab houses a fully robotic battery‑pack assembly line and integrates digital twins, industrial AI, and real‑time operational intelligence to prototype and validate autonomous production systems.

alert_news.title: ISRO Tests Uprated CE20 Engine, Boosting LVM3 Payload Capacity
bullets: First flight‑acceptance hot test of the CE20 cryogenic engine at 220 kN thrust, conducted at the ISRO Propulsion Complex (IPRC) in Mahendragiri, Tamil Nadu
165‑second test validates the uprated C32 upper stage for LVM3, enabling a 22‑tonne thrust capability and increased payload for future missions

alert_news.title: India’s first museum dedicated to linguistic diversity – Shabdalok
bullets: India’s first museum dedicated to linguistic diversity, located at Belvedere House on the National Library campus, Alipore, Kolkata.
Showcases the evolution of languages, scripts, and literary heritage across India.
Explores the relationship between language and identity through interactive galleries.

alert_news.title: India’s first nationwide genome‑wide study on endometriosis
bullets: India’s first nationwide genome‑wide study on endometriosis, involving 2,523 women across 18 centres.
Identified 21 genetic regions linked to endometriosis, including WNT4 and CDKN2B‑AS1.
Provides foundational data for precision medicine and earlier diagnosis of endometriosis in Indian women.

alert_news.title: India's First Bullet Train to Be Inaugurated in 2027
bullets: India’s first indigenously manufactured bullet train, the Mumbai‑Ahmedabad High‑Speed Rail Corridor, will open the 100‑km Surat‑Vapi section in 2027 under the Ministry of Railways.
The train will run at 320 km/h, with track trials scheduled for May‑June 2027 and full operations expected shortly after.

alert_news.title: GRSE Launches Sagar Manthan, India's First Indigenous Ocean Research Vessel for Deep ...
bullets: India’s first indigenous Ocean Research Vessel (ORV) Sagar Manthan launched by GRSE Ltd, a Navratna Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Defence.

The 89.50 m long, 5,900‑tonne ORV, built at GRSE’s Rishi Bankim Shipyard in Kolkata, will conduct deep‑sea research up to 6 km depth, equipped with Underway Swath Multibeam, Geophysical Seismic surveys, CTD profiling, and advanced sampling gear.
Scheduled for delivery in 2028, the vessel marks India’s inaugural indigenous ORV for deep‑sea exploration, enhancing national capabilities in ocean science.

alert_news.title: India's First AI Acoustic System Boosts Forest, Wildlife Conservation
bullets: India’s first AI‑based forest acoustic surveillance system deployed in Haldwani forest division, built by the Indian Forest Service.
Integrates AI, edge computing, acoustic sensors and LoRa communication; powered by solar energy for continuous, remote monitoring of illegal logging, poaching and other wildlife crimes.

alert_news.title: TCS Industrial Autonomy Lab: Pioneering AI‑First Production Systems
bullets: India’s first Industrial Autonomy & Engineering Lab (lights‑out factory lab) opened by TCS at Sahyadri Park, Pune.
Features a fully robotic battery‑pack assembly line, digital twins, robotics, AI and factory control systems to prototype and validate autonomous production.

alert_news.title: India's First Indigenously Manufactured Bullet Train to Undergo Testing by May or June 2027
bullets: India's first indigenously manufactured bullet train, scheduled for testing at Vadodara by May/June 2027, part of the Mumbai‑Ahmedabad High‑Speed Rail corridor
Built under the Ministry of Railways, the train will operate on a 508 km corridor with 12 stations, aiming to reduce travel time between Vadodara and Mumbai to 90 minutes
